features: New 'Penny-Perfect' accounting engine: all calculations are performed in whole cents, permanently eliminating rounding errors. Each expense item is atomically anchored to its instalment plan, and the system mathematically prevents the same expense from being included in two plans simultaneously.

Extraordinary instalment plans (Art. 1135 Civil Code): it is now possible to create plans independent of the budget, fed by a dynamic 'Invoice Cart' to finance unexpected expenses. Creation mandatorily requires the details of the assembly resolution or an urgency declaration, legally protecting the property manager.

Multi-line invoice registration and personal expenses: each invoice can be split into lines with independent allocation logic. A line can be charged 100% to a single owner (Art. 63) without creating fictitious millésime tables. Unexpected expenses are automatically routed to the 'Extraordinary Income' account in the general ledger (Art. 1130-bis Civil Code).

Prior debts and invoices from previous financial years: the system recognises invoices dated in past years and handles them without contaminating the current balance. A dedicated panel calculates the net bank transfer to be made, stripping withholding taxes, and triggers a red alert if the debt exceeds 5 years (Art. 2948 Civil Code — statute of limitations risk).

Overspend management with the 'Trident' (Art. 1135 Civil Code): out-of-budget expenses can be neutralised with three distinct strategies — waiting for the year-end adjustment, issuing an additional extraordinary instalment, or directly drawing from a Reserve Fund with automatic double-entry bookkeeping.

Credit note and reversal engine: credit notes are processed using the 'Write-Then-Reverse' paradigm — the double-entry record is generated as a normal invoice and only at the end are the signs surgically inverted. A balance validator blocks saving if it detects even a single cent of imbalance, with a CRITICAL log entry for the support team.

Reserve fund vault: restricted funds (severance pay, works, arrears) are locked by default. An emergency unlock mandatorily requires the details of the assembly resolution or legal justification, leaving a permanent audit trail.

Smart owner wallet: the collection panel displays past credits as a virtual 'piggy bank'. The system automatically deducts only the required amount without consuming the entire credit. The owner can declare their intention to offset from the portal, and the manager receives a contextual notification with operational instructions.

Silent instalment issuance: accounting entries are generated but owners receive no notifications and cannot see due dates in the app. A 'Publish hidden' button globally unlocks visibility once reconciliation is complete, eliminating the communication vulnerability window.

Financial X-Ray — per-owner financial breakdown: a side panel shows the mathematical composition of each instalment, broken down by millésime shares, personal expenses, and prior balances, grouped by property unit if the owner holds more than one.

Expense allocation across multiple millésime tables with adjustable coefficients: an expense item can be distributed across multiple tables with different percentages (e.g. 50% General Table + 50% Staircase Table). The system checks in real time that the total does not exceed 100% and blocks changes if the instalment plan is already approved or has issued instalments.

Separate chart of accounts for approved budget and extraordinary items: the interface shows two distinct totals — the budget approved at the assembly and unexpected expenses — avoiding artificial inflation of the approved figure. Technical entries automatically generated by the system are protected from manual editing.

Audit Dashboard and accounting traffic light: the main widget compares the budget and planned amounts in real time, flags orphan items, and shows 'Integrated Balance' status when all uncovered expenses have an assigned strategy. Instalment plans requiring recalculation generate a top-priority alert.

Direct navigation from coverage analysis to instalment plans: in each expense item's detail panel, the names of the instalment plans financing it are clickable, with the extraordinary plan correctly tracked by plan and amount rather than as a generic label.

Shared hosting compatibility (Altervista, Netsons, Aruba): resolved MySQL error 1267 (collation mismatch) that caused the dashboard to crash every 8 minutes on servers with utf8mb3_general_ci. Resolved timeout issues on Windows and hosting environments with a 60-second max_execution_time. Migrations are now self-healing: if interrupted midway, on the next attempt the system detects orphaned columns and resumes without errors.

Instalment plan temporal snapshot: adding a new item as a sub-account of a chapter already included in an active plan no longer silently and automatically includes the new item in the existing plan. The quota calculation only considers sub-accounts that existed at the time the plan was created.

Cron job management from the control panel: scheduled processes can now be configured directly from the administration interface, without accessing the server. The system is compatible with external services such as cron-job.org for shared hosting environments without native cron support, with 5-level protection (Brute-Force detection, Atomic Lock, self-healing IP Whitelist) to ensure only authorised calls can start jobs.

SMTP and Sendmail configuration from the control panel: mail server credentials (host, port, user, password, encryption) and driver selection (SMTP or PHP Sendmail) are configured directly from the panel, without editing the .env file. The configuration is persisted in the database and takes precedence over the .env file, making a mail provider change a matter of seconds even on shared hosting.
Added an option in the general settings that allows administrators to assign a default group for users who register via the frontend.

Improved owner balance management: the prior balance distribution engine has been rewritten with cascade logic. If an owner holds multiple property units, the credit or debit is automatically distributed across the units in progressive order. Cumulative collections are broken down by the system instalment by instalment without manual intervention, and the applied balance is now correctly flagged on individual records to prevent duplications.

Contextual guides and updated layout: every operational module (communications, reports, documents, agenda) displays clean breadcrumbs and informational cards in the page header describing the main features, improving orientation for new users. Statistics use semantic colours — red for urgencies, amber for deadlines, green for completed items — and clickable widgets display a micro visual feedback on hover.
